precise_historical_mechanism.erroneous_intermediate: For each unchanged two-open cover W=U∪V, the displayed raw MV short sequence is exact.
precise_historical_mechanism.corrected_intermediate: For each cover S=U0∪V, there exists an open U⊂U0 still covering S with V for which the MV short sequence is exact.
precise_historical_mechanism.why_sufficient: Use neighborhoods separating the two chosen sets of closed points. The fixed V excludes the first closed point, so every permitted U-shrinking still contains it. Exact refinements are cofinal; their colimit gives the semilocal comparison square needed for induction.
precise_historical_mechanism.no_quantifier_swap: Existence of a successful refinement is not universal exactness of the original stage.
precise_historical_mechanism.counterexample_status: No concrete original geometric counterexample constructed; optional multiplication-by-2 complex is explicitly an independent illustration only.

proof_dependency_chain: Semilocal localization and arbitrary-point conventions identify the finite closed points of S.
G1 and G2 replace F by its separated reflection without changing F(S) or its sheafification.
A neighborhood system separating the two sets of closed points keeps G3's shrinking inside the same system.
Exact refinements and filtered colimits yield the two-semilocal-piece MV sequence.
Sheaf left exactness, induction on closed-point count and right-hand injectivity prove the comparison isomorphism.
